rules-eligibility.title: Can they get one?

config.intro: Can each person get an Amateur Radio Operator Certificate?

cases.situation: A 10-year-old who passed the Basic exam.
A visitor on a work permit with a valid Canadian address who passed Basic.
cases.why: A valid address in Canada is the requirement, not citizenship.

cases.situation: Someone who passed the Morse code test but not Basic.
options: No: Basic must be passed first
cases.answer: No: Basic must be passed first
cases.why: The certificate is issued on passing Basic.

cases.situation: A Basic holder wants Morse code before Advanced.
cases.why: Additional qualifications can be taken in any order.

rules-eligibility.success: Pass Basic, have a Canadian address: that's it.
